summary: End-to-end testing of Meridian Medical Studio: backend appointment/availability APIs + frontend Doctor Profile, Patient Stories, and Live Availability slot picker. All 8 backend pytest cases passed and all UI flows (dialog open, day tabs, slot select, submit, confirmation, booked-slot state on reopen, mobile menu, 3-col slot grid) worked as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py next_business_days() uses local timezone offset from UTC via .astimezone() which is fine on this container but slot IDs are generated in local tz — good, matches availability/create validation. No issue.
AppointmentDialog focus-trap loops through 'button, input, textarea' — day tabs and slot chips are all buttons so tab traversal cycles through many items; acceptable.
No rate-limiting on POST /api/appointments — for a public form this could be spammed; consider IP-based throttling in future.
load_dotenv path is correct, MONGO_URL/DB_NAME are required with no defaults — good fail-fast behavior.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ appointments during testing; all cleaned up. Final appointment count in DB: 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_meridian_api.py covers health, availability structure (5 days × 16 slots, 9AM–4:30PM), create success + persistence (slot flips to available=false), 409 duplicate, 400 invalid slot, 422 name/email validation, and reverse-chrono listing. Frontend uses import.meta.env.VITE_BACKEND_URL || '' i.e. same-origin '/api/...' through ingress — works. Note: framer-motion viewport animations sometimes cause Playwright to lose element context after navigation/scroll — call scrollIntoView + wait before querying doctor/stories sub-elements.
